unit_rules.name: The Nomad
unit_rules.text: This model can Shoot and Charge after making an Advance move. In addition, friendly +Shattered Legions+ units wholly within 6" can Shoot after making an Advance move.

unit_rules.name: Bodyguards of the Nomad
unit_rules.text: While within 3" of a friendly +Shattered Legions+ +Infantry+ or +Mounted+ unit and not a +Leader+, this model has +Lone Operative+.
